item.title: WEPACK 2026 결산 — 137,157명이 모인 글로벌 종이 포장 격전지, 선전

item.description: In April 2026, the Korea Fair Trade Commission (KFTC) delivered the largest-ever penalty to the domestic paper industry: a ₩338.3 billion (approximately USD 244 million) combined fine against six paper manufacturers found guilty of coordinating printing paper prices over a period of nearly four year...
